# HARDROCK Sand and Gravel

> HARDROCK Sand and Gravel is a sand and gravel supplier in Sherman, TX, in business since 2019, delivering pea gravel, 57 and 67 rock, road base, decomposed granite, mason sand, river rock, rip rap and fill dirt to Sherman, Denison and Grayson County, and handling driveways, house pads, ponds and land clearing.

## Business Information
- Business name: HARDROCK Sand and Gravel
- Type: Sand & gravel supplier
- Owner: Dean Jones
- Phone: 903-420-0330
- Email: dean@hardrocksandandgravel.com
- Location: Sherman, TX
- Hours: Mon 6:00 AM – 5:00 PM, Tue 6:00 AM – 5:00 PM, Wed 6:00 AM – 5:00 PM, Thu 6:00 AM – 5:00 PM, Fri 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM, Sat 9:00 AM – 2:00 PM, Sun Closed
- Service area: Sherman, TX; Denison, TX; Grayson County, TX

## About
HARDROCK Sand and Gravel is a local sand and gravel supplier serving Sherman, Denison and Grayson County, TX, in business since 2019. Services include delivery, pea gravel, 57 rock and 67 rock. Owner: Dean Jones. Orders are priced by phone based on the material, the amount and the delivery address. Call 903-420-0330 for availability and pricing.
